reviewer: Pickle: official-source winter scalp flaking, seborrheic dermatitis causes, antifungal active comparison, water temperature and hair drying evidence, and Coupang product terms
method: Reviewed the draft against 17 sources on 2026-11-12. Indoor humidity: the KIEAE Journal 13(3) 2013 field survey measured 20 Cheongju apartments between 2010-12-28 and 2011-03-11 and reports mean winter RH of 35.4 % (range 23.0-54.1 %) against a 50±20 % guideline, with the 6 apartments (30 %) under the 40 % guideline averaging 26.7 %; the KJHE 20(1) 2011 survey of 5 senior halls in February 2009 reports 22.0-48.2 % RH and notes that higher indoor temperature from heating made units drier. Seborrheic dermatitis: the KDCA national health portal entry (updated 2026-10-01) states a worldwide prevalence around 5 %, names Malassezia globosa and M. restricta among 14 known species as the most relevant, lists autumn/winter low temperature and low indoor humidity as aggravating factors, and names zinc pyrithione, selenium sulfide, ketoconazole, ciclopirox and salicylic acid shampoos at 2-3 times a week; it also states twice that forcibly removing scales with keratolytics or physical methods can worsen inflammation, which is the basis for the article's warning about scalp scalers. The portal's resource answer (health_colmn_sn=4225) supplies the pityriasis sicca definition and the view that dandruff is the mildest form of seborrheic dermatitis. Ketoconazole: the MFDS nedrug label for 니조랄2%액 (item 201802157) fixes the 3-5 minute contact time, twice weekly for 2-4 weeks, then once every 1-2 weeks for relapse prevention. Comparative trial: Danby et al., J Am Acad Dermatol 1993;29:1008-12 randomized 246 patients (ketoconazole 2 % 97, selenium sulfide 2.5 % 100, vehicle 49), found both actives better than vehicle at every visit, ketoconazole superior only at day 8 (p=0.0026), and all nine adverse experiences in the selenium sulfide arm, including hair lightening and orange scalp staining. Zinc pyrithione: Schwartz, J Drugs Dermatol 2016;15:140-44 explains the broad antimicrobial spectrum and the particulate slow-release deposition that makes same-level products perform differently. Selenium sulfide plus salicylic acid and the up-to-50 % dandruff / 5 % SD prevalence figures come from the EADV 2021 poster page. MSD Manual Korean consumer edition gives the ketoconazole twice-weekly then weekly schedule and the daily-to-every-other-day then twice-weekly schedule for zinc pyrithione, selenium sulfide, salicylic acid, sulfur and tar. Drying: Lee et al., Ann Dermatol 2011;23:455-62 ran five groups (untreated, air dry at 20 C, 47 C at 15 cm for 60 s, 61 C at 10 cm for 30 s, 95 C at 5 cm for 15 s) over 30 treatments and found more surface damage with higher temperature, the least damage at 47 C, cell membrane complex damage only in the air-dried group, and air drying taking over 2 hours in their setup. Water temperature: the 2026-10-16 Pickdaily article reports lukewarm 36-38 C guidance and Cleveland Clinic's advice that hotter water dries skin more, which the Cleveland Clinic winter dry skin page itself confirms along with running the heat lowering indoor humidity; I deliberately did not restate a '38 C' figure as Cleveland Clinic's own wording where only the secondary report carries it. Shampoo interval: Park et al., J Invest Cosmetol 2011;7:37-44 tracked sebum, moisture and keratin on four scalp sites of five women over 24 hours and concluded an interval of about 24 hours. Products checked on Coupang on 2026-11-12: 헤드앤숄더 프로페셔널 안티 댄드러프 어드밴스드 가려운 두피 케어 샴푸 300 ml at 11,460 won after a 1,620 won wow coupon off a 17,900 won list price, 16,904 reviews, 'more than 9,000 bought in the last month', today delivery and free shipping, made in China; 닥터포헤어 딥 클렌징 두피 스케일러 250 g at 16,800 won, 883 reviews, free shipping, next-day delivery, while the same brand's 씨솔트 기획 (+60 g) was 27,150 won with 1 review, 11/18 arrival and 5 units left; 라보에이치 프로바이오틱스 탈모 완화 민감더마 샴푸 400 ml at 15,200 won (47 % off 28,900 won), 4,570 reviews. I corrected the brief's product list against the actual listings: the brief's first pick 헤드앤숄더 클리니컬 스트렝스 exists only as cross-border listings that add a 10,000 won shipping charge to the 9,100 won price (19,100 won total) with a 11/24 arrival and a mandatory-disclosure table that reads only '상품 상세페이지 참조', so no ingredient can be confirmed on the page; the article discloses those terms and does not recommend it as a first purchase, and the ranking box instead uses the domestic 헤드앤숄더 professional anti-dandruff line whose price, review count and delivery are all visible. The brief's scalp scaler pick 닥터포헤어 폴리젠 씨솔트 was replaced by the same brand's 250 g 딥 클렌징 scaler because the 씨솔트 set had 1 review, 5 units left and a 11/18 arrival; the article names the 씨솔트 set with its real terms so the reader can choose. The brief's third name mixes two lines: 라보에이치 프로바이오틱스 탈모 완화 민감더마 샴푸 is the real 'probiotics, sensitive derma' product, so that one is used rather than the separate 두피강화 클리닉 line. Kakao Gift curator links are reused live links (9rNUCeSC 오아 무선 미니 가습기) because the curator dashboard still returns a DKAPTCHA challenge, so the gift section frames the humidity side of the problem and sends scalp purchases to the Coupang box above. Verified no 진단/치료법/처방/복용법/부작용 wording in title, description, targetQuery, secondaryQueries or tags; all 34 tildes were converted to en dashes after the first live render showed three <del> strike-through artifacts from 3~5 minute, 2~4 week and 5~10 minute ranges; category set to home because the site has no 'life' taxonomy entry (it, living, public, home, travel) and existing health guides sit in home. Measured overlap with existing posts: body 15 % with the cracked heels guide, title 32 %, query 18 %. Gate score 100/100.
